newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse slightly up in higher volume trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse slightly up in higher volume trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Monday closed slightly up by 0.09 percent in higher trade, bourse sources said.
The all-share index closed at 458.79 points, up from 458.36 on Friday.
Total volume was three million dinars against 2.7 million dinars over the previous session. Turnover on the first market was 1.42 million dinars with the exchange of 50,390 shares.

Chemical firm Alkimia dropped 3.22 dinars to 40.78 dinars with only 10 shares changing hands. Alkimia said that 146,300 new shares worth ten dinars each were being distributed free of charge to shareholders as part of a capital raising move.
Milk firm Tunisie Lait fell 0.68 dinar to 22.36 dinars.
Banque Internationale Arabe de Tunisie eased 0.48 dinar to 29.2 dinars. UIB bank declined 0.34 dinar to 11.62.
Airline Tunis Air edged lower 0.12 dinar to 22.64 dinars. Palm Beach Hotels declined 0.12 dinar to 9.88.
Amen Bank was up 0.84 dinar to 30 dinars on trade of 12,094 shares. Banque de Tunisie rose 0.1 dinar to 75 dinars.
Most of the trade was on leasing firm Tunisie Leasing LEAS.TN with 26,154 shares changing hands at the price of 30.86 dinars.

Societe Tunisienne de Banques, Banque du Sud and Banque Nationale Agricole were traded for the first time on the new computerised dealing system but no contracts were concluded. The electronic dealing, which started last October, is now at 31 firms out of 31 shares on the first market. ($1=1.09 dinar)
